title: Sort Names (stdin)
hints: Store each person as a labelled tuple.
Sort by the tuple (lowercased last name, lowercased first name).
jsBridge: Sort by last name, then first name, case-insensitively, with a tuple key and `lowercased()`. For real names, `localizedStandardCompare` and `PersonNameComponentsFormatter` are the Foundation answer.

compass.q: "van Gogh", "O'Brien", single names, three-part names: how does "last name" break down?
Tuple of lowercased strings vs `KeyPathComparator` with `.localized`: which handles accents correctly?
Contact lists sort by family name in some locales and given name in others. What does `CNContactFormatter` do?
